author: Ken Allard
title: Motorcyclist dies in Stockton collision, second fatal crash in hours - NewsBreak
text:
By Ken Allard ,
3 hours ago
FOX40.COM) — A motorcyclist was killed in Stockton on Wednesday, the second fatal motorcycle accident in the city within hours.
The Stockton Police Department said a motorcycle and a vehicle collided near Harrison Street and Harding Way in the Civic District.
Video: Temperatures peaking at 69, Thursday should see wind gusts
The male motorcyclist was unresponsive when officers arrived. He was transported to an area hospital, where he later died.
A motorcyclist died in an early Wednesday morning crash in Stockton in the area of East Main Street and South Oro Avenue. It happened around 6:34 a.m.
California Highway Patrol said the motorcyclist crashed into a fence.
